channel.title: LG Growth Studio Research
channel.description: Research on websites, SEO, performance and growth.

item.title: Your Website Is Judged in 50 Milliseconds. Here’s What the Research Actually Says
item.description: Research shows people form visual impressions of websites almost instantly. Learn what that means for credibility, hierarchy, conversion and redesign decisions.

item.title: Google Doesn’t Need More Blog Posts. It Needs a Site It Can Understand
item.description: Publishing more content is not an SEO strategy. Learn how information architecture, internal links, service pages and people-first content create durable search visibility.

item.title: The 2.5-Second Problem: Why a Beautiful Website Can Still Lose Customers
item.description: A practical guide to Core Web Vitals, LCP, INP and CLS—and why performance failures make premium websites feel broken before users can appreciate the design.

item.title: AI Search Changed SEO—But Not the Way Most Agencies Claim
item.description: Google says AI Overviews and AI Mode do not require a secret new optimization playbook. Learn what actually matters for AI search visibility and durable SEO.

item.title: Your Mobile Site Is Your Real Website Now. Design Like It
item.description: Google uses the mobile version of your site for indexing. Learn how mobile-first design changes SEO, conversion, content hierarchy, forms and performance.

item.title: Most Websites Are Still Inaccessible. That’s a Business Problem, Not a Checkbox
item.description: WebAIM found detectable WCAG failures on most major homepages. Learn why accessibility improves usability, resilience and the quality of modern website design.

item.title: The SEO Security Problem Nobody Talks About: What Happens After a Website Gets Hacked
item.description: A hacked website can create spam pages, malware warnings and search losses. Learn how security, Search Console, cleanup and SEO recovery fit together.

item.title: Local SEO Is Not a Map Pack Trick. It’s a Trust System
item.description: Google says local results depend mainly on relevance, distance and prominence. Learn how websites, Business Profiles, reviews and operations create local growth.

item.title: “More Traffic” Is Often the Wrong Growth Goal. Here’s the Metric That Matters More
item.description: Traffic without intent or conversion can waste budget. Learn how to measure qualified demand, friction, lead handling and revenue instead of chasing sessions.

item.title: Structured Data Won’t Rank You #1—So Why Does It Matter?
item.description: Structured data is not a ranking shortcut. Learn what schema markup actually does, when rich results are possible, and how to implement JSON-LD without creating false signals.

item.title: Stop Patching It: The Evidence-Based Test for When a Website Should Be Rebuilt
item.description: Should you redesign your website or keep patching it? Use a practical framework covering performance, security, mobile UX, SEO, accessibility and maintainability.
